summary: Scalar-deleting destructor: runs VTableSubInit on the object, then, when the deletion-flag bit a2&1 is set, frees the object through FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns the this pointer unchanged.

operations.description: Calls VTableSubInit(this) to run the vtable/teardown init path before any free.
Tests the low bit of the a2 flag parameter; the freeing path is taken only when (a2 & 1) is non-zero.
Calls FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to release the object storage when the deletion flag is set.
Returns the original this pointer to the caller regardless of which branch ran.

unresolved: Object type and the work performed by VTableSubInit are unknown; no fields or globals are accessed at this level.
No callers in the packet, so the destroy sequence context is unobserved.
